Plain text with **bold**, *italic*, `code` and a [link](https://example.com/a?b=1).

Nested **bold with *italic* inside** and *italic with **bold** inside*.

Escapes stay as typed: 2 \* 3 and a \[bracket\] and snake_case_word.

Code with a backtick: ``a ` b`` and a [link with `code`](https://example.com).
